> rclone: github.com/rclone/rclone/lib/pacer.(*TokenDispenser).Get(...)
> rclone:         /home/runner/work/rclone/src/github.com/rclone/rclone/lib/pacer/tokens.go:24

This bit makes me think that rclone has run out of simultaneous FTP connections.

Try setting the `concurrency` higher in the backend config.

I have concurrency set to 3, because it's the max that OVH allows on their free FTP backup services. I had set to 0 before and I was getting many "too much connections" errors.

I set it to 1 now, just for funzies, but there was no visible changes. It hanged in the same spot.

Additional info that may help you: seems like all the files got transferred into destination directory, only their ACLs are not set yet (but that's restic's job i think). So maybe it's a problem with closing ftp connections?

> I set it to 1 now, just for funzies, but there was no visible changes. It hanged in the same spot.

You need to set it bigger to work around the problem.

From the traceback there don't appear to be any connections in use which is odd.

When it locks up can you run a `netstat -tuanp | grep rclone` and show what it says?

> So maybe it's a problem with closing ftp connections?

It could be. It could also be that a concurrency token got leaked somehow. Where there any ERRORs in the log?

> When it locks up can you run a netstat -tuanp | grep rclone and show what it says?
